cards.name: Obi-Wan Kenobi Jedi Knight
cards.gametext: Adds power bonus when he is using Obi-Wan's Lightsaber.

cards.name: Qui-Gon Jinn Jedi Ambassador
cards.gametext: Deploys for 3 if stacking with Qui-Gon Jinn, Jedi Master.

cards.name: Jar Jar Binks Bombad Gungan General
cards.gametext: Adds power bonus when he is fighting any Tank.

cards.name: Anakin Skywalker Padawan
cards.lore: What will happen to me now? - Anakin

cards.name: Captain Panaka Veteran Leader
cards.lore: Red group! Blue group! Everybody this way! - Captain Panaka

cards.name: Padme Naberrie Amidala's Handmaiden
cards.lore: I'm not sure what will happen. - Padme

cards.name: Mace Windu Jedi Speaker
cards.gametext: Deploys for 3 if Yoda, Jedi Master is present.

cards.name: Queen Amidala Keeper of the Peace
cards.lore: I come before you in peace. - Queen Amidala

cards.name: Queen Amidala Resolute Negotiator
cards.lore: I will not condone a course of action that will lead us to war. - Queen Amidala

cards.name: Yoda Jedi Elder
cards.gametext: Deploys for 2 if Mace Windu, Jedi Master is present.

cards.name: Ric Olie Bravo Leader
cards.lore: Deflector shields up at maximum. - Ric Olie

cards.name: R2-D2 The Queen's Hero
cards.lore: That little droid did it! He bypassed the main power drive. - Ric Olie

cards.name: Boss Nass Gungan Chief
cards.lore: Yousa all bombad. - Boss Nass

cards.name: Sio Bibble Governor of Naboo
cards.lore: Negotiation? We've lost all communications! - Sio Bibble

cards.name: Sabe Handmaiden Decoy Queen
cards.lore: We have searched you out because we wish to form an alliance. - Queen Amidala

cards.name: Captain Tarpals Gungan Officer
cards.lore: Noah gain, Jar Jar. - Captain Tarpals

cards.name: Sache Handmaiden
cards.lore: We can enter the palace and capture the Viceroy. - Queen Amidala

cards.name: Yane Handmaiden
cards.lore: I'm sorry for my deception, but it was necessary to protect myself. - Queen Amidala

cards.name: Naboo Officer Squad Leader
cards.lore: Once we're inside, we shouldn't have a problem. - Captain Panaka

cards.name: Naboo Security Trooper
cards.lore: We have a plan, which should immobilize the droid army. - Queen Amidala

cards.name: Naboo Officer Commander
cards.lore: We'll handle this. - Qui-Gon

cards.name: Naboo Bureaucrat Official
cards.lore: We must continue to rely on negotiation. - Queen Amidala

cards.name: Bravo Pilot Ace Flyer
cards.lore: We will send what pilots we have to knock out the Droid Control Ship. - Queen Amidala

cards.name: Naboo Security Defender
cards.lore: We must do something quickly to stop the Federation. - Queen Amidala

cards.name: Coruscant Guard Chancellor's Escort
cards.lore: Coruscant Guards travel with the Supreme Chancellor to other planets.

cards.name: Gungan Warrior Veteran
cards.lore: When in trouble, Gungans go to sacred place. - Jar Jar

cards.name: Alderaan Diplomat Senator
cards.lore: The delegation from Alderaan holds much power in the Galactic Senate.

cards.name: Council Member Naboo Governor
cards.lore: Our only hope is for the Senate to side with us. - Sio Bibble

cards.name: Gungan Soldier Infantry
cards.lore: The Gungans must draw the droid army away from the cities. - Queen Amidala

cards.name: Gungan Guard Lookout
cards.lore: Deysa comin! - Gungan guard

cards.name: Gungan General Army Leader
cards.lore: Ex-squeeze-me, but de mostest safest place would be Gunga City. - Jar Jar

cards.name: Rep Officer Gungan Diplomat
cards.lore: Yousa no tinken yousa greater den da Gungans? - Boss Nass

cards.name: Obi-Wan Kenobi Jedi Negotiator
cards.lore: I am grateful you think I am ready to take the trials. - Obi-Wan

cards.name: Eeth Koth's Lightsaber
cards.lore: Only a highly trained individual can survive with a lightsaber against a blaster attack.

cards.name: Mace Windu's Lightsaber
cards.lore: Protect the Queen, but do not intercede if it comes to war... - Mace Windu

cards.name: Captain Tarpals' Electropole
cards.lore: When Jar Jar returned to Gunga City, he was greeted by the business end of Tarpals' weapon.

cards.name: Planetary Shuttle
cards.lore: The Supreme Chancellor's personal transport has the official red color of consular craft.

cards.name: Fambaa
cards.lore: Fambaas are the perfect conveyances for carrying Gungan shield generators into battle.

cards.name: Electropole
cards.lore: A Gungan warrior trains to use his electropole like a quarterstaff in combat.

cards.name: Kaadu
cards.lore: A Gungan and his kaadu seem to be an almost inseparable team.

cards.name: Flash Speeder
cards.lore: The Flash speeder normally flies less than a meter off the ground.

cards.name: Blaster
cards.lore: Most blaster weapons have variable levels of intensity from stun to killing bolts.

cards.name: Heavy Blaster
cards.lore: Long-barreled heavy blasters offer greater range and more substantial damage than a pistol.

cards.name: Darth Maul Dark Lord of the Sith
cards.gametext: Deploys for 3 if stacking with Darth Maul, Sith Apprentice.

cards.name: Darth Sidious Sith Manipulator
cards.gametext: Adds power bonus and subtracts 1 from his DAMAGE when he is using any Sith Lightsaber.

cards.name: Sebulba Dangerous Podracer Pilot
cards.lore: Poodoo! - Sebulba

cards.name: Watto Toydarian Gambler
cards.lore: You won this small toss, outlander, but you won't winna the race! - Watto

cards.name: Aurra Sing Mercenary
cards.gametext: Adds power bonus when she is using Aurra Sing's Blaster Rifle.

cards.name: Jabba the Hutt Crime Lord
cards.lore: Shloss go du boska mallya! - Jabba the Hutt

cards.name: Nute Gunray Neimoidian Despot
cards.gametext: Adds power bonus when he is fighting Queen Amidala.

cards.name: Rune Haako Neimoidian Deputy
cards.gametext: Adds power bonus when he is fighting any handmaiden.

cards.name: Destroyer Droid Squad Guard Division
cards.lore: Destroyer droids can generate their own deflector shields.

cards.name: Battle Droid Squad Guard Unit
cards.lore: There are more active battle droids than galactic leaders would prefer to admit.

cards.name: Trade Federation Tank Guard Division
cards.lore: The nose of the AAT is almost solid armor, designed to crash through heavy walls.

cards.name: Trade Federation Tank Patrol Division
cards.lore: Up to six battle droids can ride the tank using the handholds on either side.

cards.name: P-59 Destroyer Droid Commander
cards.lore: Destroyer droid P-59 was the first to encounter the Jedi ambassadors.

cards.name: OOM-9 Battle Droid Commander
cards.lore: OOM-9 commanded the Trade Federation tanks to open fire on the Gungan army.

cards.name: Daultay Dofine Neimoidian Attendant
cards.lore: We dare not go against these Jedi. - Daultay Dofine

cards.name: Diva Shaliqua Singer
cards.lore: Jabba's constant need for entertainment means that he must hire professionals.

cards.name: Diva Funquita Dancer
cards.lore: The vile gangster Jabba employs professional dancers for his own amusement.

cards.name: Bith Musician
cards.lore: Bith perceive sounds very well, making them excellent entertainers and musicians.

cards.name: Quarren Smuggler
cards.lore: Sometimes called "squid heads," Quarren often work as pirates and smugglers.

cards.name: Toonbuck Toora Senator
cards.lore: Vote now! Vote now! - Assembly

cards.name: Aqualish Galactic Senator
cards.lore: The "walrus-faced" Aqualish come from the swampy islands of the planet Ando.

cards.name: Twi'lek Diplomat Senator
cards.lore: Many of the delegations to the Galactic Senate have numerous aides and assistants.

cards.name: Weequay Enforcer
cards.lore: Weequay on Tatooine are primitive warriors who work for Jabba the Hutt.

cards.name: Nikto Slave
cards.lore: Among the slave species Jabba brought to Tatooine are the Nikto.

cards.name: Pacithhip Prospector
cards.lore: Pacithhip are dangerous fighters when cornered, attacking with their sharp tusks.

cards.name: Destroyer Droid Vanguard Droid
cards.lore: Heavy-hitting destroyer droids are elite and deadly combat machines.

cards.name: Destroyer Droid MTT Infantry
cards.lore: Destroyer droids have permanent weapons in place of hands.

cards.name: Sith Probe Droid Remote Tracker
cards.lore: Darth Maul can control up to six of these droids with his wristband comlink.

cards.name: Battle Droid: Pilot Patrol Division
cards.lore: Trade Federation battle droids can set down their weapons and operate machinery.

cards.name: Battle Droid: Security Patrol Division
cards.lore: Battle droids are utterly heartless in the performance of their duties.

cards.name: Battle Droid: Infantry Patrol Division
cards.lore: Battle droids are the footsoldiers of the Trade Federation Army.

cards.name: Battle Droid: Officer Patrol Division
cards.lore: All battle droids are controlled from a remote command source.

cards.name: Battle Droid: Pilot Defense Division
cards.lore: Specialized droid pilots operate the starships and vehicles of the Trade Federation.

cards.name: Battle Droid: Security Defense Division
cards.lore: Halt! - battle droid

cards.name: Battle Droid: Infantry Defense Division
cards.lore: Roger Roger. - battle droid

cards.name: Battle Droid: Officer Defense Division
cards.lore: Sheer force of numbers overwhelms the enemies of the battle droid army.

cards.name: Neimoidian Advisor Bureaucrat
cards.lore: The Senate is full of greedy, squabbling delegates. - Senator Palpatine

cards.name: Darth Maul Evil Sith Lord
cards.lore: This will work to our advantage. - Darth Sidious

cards.name: Darth Maul's Lightsaber
cards.lore: Darth Maul is a master of the esoteric and deadly art of the double-bladed lightsaber.

cards.name: Sith Lightsaber
cards.lore: Lightsabers can be powerful weapons after their users undergo extensive training.

cards.name: Darth Maul's Electrobinoculars
cards.lore: The evil Sith Lord uses remote-controlled hunter-seeker droids to locate his prey.

cards.name: Trade Federation Tank Laser Cannon
cards.lore: The primary armament of a Trade Federation tank is a turreted laser cannon.

cards.name: Multi Troop Transport
cards.lore: The MTT has four laser cannons and an internal transport rack storing 112 battle droids.

cards.name: STAP
cards.lore: The Single Troop Aerial Platform is typically dispatched ahead of the main army as a scout.

cards.name: Battle Droid Blaster Rifle
cards.lore: Battle droids are issued a specialized make of blaster rifle.

cards.name: Blaster
cards.lore: The most common sidearm is the high-energy laser beam weapon commonly called a blaster.

cards.name: Blaster Rifle
cards.lore: Blaster rifles have better long-range targeting because of their extendable stocks.

cards.name: A Thousand Terrible Things
cards.lore: If they find us, they will crush us, grind us into tiny pieces and blast us into oblivion! - Obi-Wan

cards.name: Armored Assault
cards.lore: Trade Federation tanks have handholds so that battle droids can ride them.

cards.name: Death From Above
cards.lore: Landing craft have a double-wing design to provide stability during rapid atmospheric descents.

cards.name: Don't Spect A Werm Welcome
cards.lore: This has not been our day for warm welcomes. - Obi-Wan

cards.name: I Will Make It Legal
cards.lore: My Lord, is that legal? - Nute Gunray

cards.name: Not For A Sith
cards.lore: It's impossible. - Nute Gunray

cards.name: Now There Are Two Of Them
cards.lore: This is getting out of hand. - Nute Gunray

cards.name: Sith Force Push
cards.lore: The Chancellor should never have brought them into this. Kill them immediately. - Darth Sidious

cards.name: The Phantom Menace
cards.lore: I will see to it that in the Senate things stay as they are. - Darth Sidious

cards.name: They Win This Round
cards.lore: Put down your weapons. - Queen Amidala

cards.name: We Are Sending All Troops
cards.lore: Activate the droids. - Daultay Dofine

cards.name: After Her!
cards.lore: This one's a decoy! - Nute Gunray

cards.name: Da Dug Chaaa!
cards.lore: Ni chuba na? - Sebulba

cards.name: Sando Aqua Monster
cards.lore: Naboo's snake-bodied leviathan has snapping jaws and an insatiable appetite.

cards.name: They Will Not Stay Hidden For Long
cards.lore: My troops are in position to begin searching the swamps. - OOM-9

cards.name: This Is Too Close!
cards.lore: I thought the battle was going to take place far from here! - Nute Gunray

cards.name: Droid Control Ship Trade Federation Transport
cards.lore: Transmission towers on the Droid Control Ship broadcast vital command signals.

cards.name: Sith Infiltrator Starfighter
cards.lore: Sith apprentices have maintained a tradition of special personal starships.

cards.name: Droid Starfighter
cards.lore: Each droid starfighter has compartments that slide open to reveal laser cannons.

cards.name: Battleship Trade Federation Transport
cards.lore: Large areas of Trade Federation battleships are undefended by quadlaser batteries.
